coreEngine.name: 2-Bar Rolling Buffer
coreEngine.description: Continuously recording audio buffer with real-time playback position manipulation

timeEnvelope.visualRepresentation: 2D grid showing buffer position over time

slotSystem.simultaneousTrigger: Time and Volume slots can be triggered independently or together

processing.algorithm: Real-time buffer read with variable interpolation
processing.timeStretchQuality: Optimized for real-time performance (not high-quality offline)
processing.phaseResponse: Minimal phase shift (depends on buffer position)

optimizationTips: Freeze tracks with Gross Beat for CPU-intensive projects

Commit to audio when arrangement is finalized

midiImplementation.ccSupport: Standard FL Studio VST parameter mapping

limitations.noTrueReverse: Cannot reverse audio - only manipulates playback direction
limitations.frequencyContent: All frequency ranges affected equally (no band selection)

integration.flStudio: Native plugin with full Patcher support
integration.otherDAWs: Available as VST2/VST3 (with reduced MIDI functionality)
integration.sidechain: Can receive sidechain input for ducking
